parsed_reminder:
The task explicitly requires "checks that catch cases of non-log-concave densities during the sampling process." Disabling check_log_concavity entirely violates this requirement, even though the numerical precision issues are real.

The claim that "rejection sampling naturally handles non-log-concave cases" is not supported - ARS is designed specifically for log-concave densities and may fail silently or produce incorrect samples on non-log-concave inputs.

Consider alternatives that satisfy the requirement while avoiding false positives: check only during initialization with a small set of test points, implement a more robust numerical check (finite differences rather than tangent extrapolation), or add the check as an optional parameter with appropriate warnings. The requirement cannot be dropped.
